entities.name: Fernando Alonso
entities.description: Aged seven, Alonso won his first kart race in Pola de Laviana. He won the 1988 and 1989 children's junior Championship of the Asturias and Galicia, and progressed to the Cadet class in 1990.

entities.name: Pola de Laviana
entities.description: The location where Alonso won his first kart race.

entities.name: Championship of the Asturias
entities.description: A children's junior championship won by Alonso in 1988 and 1989.

entities.name: Championship of Galicia
entities.description: A children's junior championship won by Alonso in 1988 and 1989.

entities.name: José Luis Echevarria
entities.description: Kart track owner who told Genís Marcó about Alonso.
